tools.name: read_pulsetic_page
tools.description: Read a page of pulsetic.com as Markdown, for example "/pricing/" for plans and limits, "/status/github/" for a service's status, or "/llms.txt" for an overview of the whole site.

tools.name: search_service_status
tools.description: Search Pulsetic's directory of more than 4,300 third-party services (GitHub, Slack, Stripe and so on) and return each match's current status label and the URL of its Pulsetic status page, which has visitor reports, the outage map and incident history.

query.description: Service name or domain, for example "github" or "slack.com".
